en.sayed-ali-raza: I praise Allāh for whatever matter He ordained and whatever action He destines, and for my trial with you, O’ group
of people who do not obey when I order and do not respond when I call you.
If you are at ease you engage in (conceited) conversation, but if you are faced with battle you show weakness.
If people agree on one Imām you taunt each other.
If you are faced with an arduous matter you turn away from it.
May others have no father (woe to your enemy!) what are you waiting for, in the matter of your assistance and for fighting for your rights?
For you there is either death or disgrace.
By Allāh, if my day (of death) comes, and it is sure to come, it will cause separation between me and you, although I am sick of your company
